annotations.text: The downloads API allows to download files and to monitor, manipulate, and search for downloads.

events.description: This event fires with the DownloadItem object when a download begins.
events.name: onCreated

events.description: Fires with the downloadId when a download is erased from history.
events.name: onErased

parameters.description: The id of the DownloadItem that was erased.
parameters.name: downloadId

events.description: When any of a DownloadItem's properties except bytesReceived changes, this event fires with the downloadId and an object containing the properties that changed.
events.name: onChanged

functions.description: Download a URL. If the URL uses the HTTP[S] protocol, then the request will include all cookies currently set for its hostname. If both filename and saveAs are specified, then the Save As dialog will be displayed, pre-populated with the specified filename. If the download started successfully, callback will be called with the new DownloadItem's downloadId. If there was an error starting the download, then callback will be called with downloadId=undefined and chrome.extension.lastError will contain a descriptive string. The error strings are not guaranteed to remain backwards compatible between releases. You must not parse it.
functions.name: download

allowHttpErrors.description: When this flag is set to true, then the browser will allow downloads to proceed after encountering HTTP errors such as 404 Not Found.

cookieStoreId.description: The cookie store ID of the contextual identity; requires "cookies" permission.

filename.description: A file path relative to the Downloads directory to contain the downloaded file.

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers to send with the request if the URL uses the HTTP[s] protocol. Each header is represented as a dictionary containing the keys name and either value or binaryValue, restricted to those allowed by XMLHttpRequest.

incognito.description: Whether to associate the download with a private browsing session.

method.description: The HTTP method to use if the URL uses the HTTP[S] protocol.

saveAs.description: Use a file-chooser to allow the user to select a filename. If the option is not specified, the file chooser will be shown only if the Thunderbird "Always ask you where to save files" option is enabled (i.e. the pref browser.download.useDownloadDir is set to false).

functions.description: Find DownloadItems. Set query to the empty object to get all DownloadItems. To get a specific DownloadItem, set only the id field.
functions.name: search

functions.description: Pause the download. If the request was successful the download is in a paused state. Otherwise chrome.extension.lastError contains an error message. The request will fail if the download is not active.
functions.name: pause

parameters.description: The id of the download to pause.
parameters.name: downloadId

functions.description: Resume a paused download. If the request was successful the download is in progress and unpaused. Otherwise chrome.extension.lastError contains an error message. The request will fail if the download is not active.
functions.name: resume

parameters.description: The id of the download to resume.
parameters.name: downloadId

functions.description: Cancel a download. When callback is run, the download is cancelled, completed, interrupted or doesn't exist anymore.
functions.name: cancel

parameters.description: The id of the download to cancel.
parameters.name: downloadId

functions.description: Retrieve an icon for the specified download. For new downloads, file icons are available after the onCreated event has been received. The image returned by this function while a download is in progress may be different from the image returned after the download is complete. Icon retrieval is done by querying the underlying operating system or toolkit depending on the platform. The icon that is returned will therefore depend on a number of factors including state of the download, platform, registered file types and visual theme. If a file icon cannot be determined, chrome.extension.lastError will contain an error message.
functions.name: getFileIcon

size.description: The size of the icon.  The returned icon will be square with dimensions size * size pixels.  The default size for the icon is 32x32 pixels.

functions.description: Show the downloaded file in its folder in a file manager.
functions.name: show

functions.description: Prompt the user to either accept or cancel a dangerous download. acceptDanger() does not automatically accept dangerous downloads.
functions.name: acceptDanger

functions.description: Initiate dragging the file to another application.
functions.name: drag

types.description: These string constants will never change, however the set of DangerTypes may change.

content.description: The downloaded file is known to be malicious.

safe.description: The download presents no known danger to the user's computer.

uncommon.description: The download's URL is not commonly downloaded and could be dangerous.

url.description: The download's URL is known to be malicious.

types.description: These string constants will never change, however the set of States may change.

in_progress.description: The download is currently receiving data from the server.

interrupted.description: An error broke the connection with the file host.

bytesReceived.description: Number of bytes received so far from the host, without considering file compression.

cookieStoreId.description: The cookie store ID of the contextual identity.

danger.description: Indication of whether this download is thought to be safe or known to be suspicious.

endTime.description: Number of milliseconds between the unix epoch and when this download ended.

error.description: Number indicating why a download was interrupted.

fileSize.description: Number of bytes in the whole file post-decompression, or -1 if unknown.

id.description: An identifier that is persistent across browser sessions.

incognito.description: False if this download is recorded in the history, true if it is not recorded.

paused.description: True if the download has stopped reading data from the host, but kept the connection open.

startTime.description: Number of milliseconds between the unix epoch and when this download began.

state.description: Indicates whether the download is progressing, interrupted, or complete.

totalBytes.description: Number of bytes in the whole file, without considering file compression, or -1 if unknown.

types.description: A time specified as a Date object, a number or string representing milliseconds since the epoch, or an ISO 8601 string
Parameters that combine to specify a predicate that can be used to select a set of downloads.  Used for example in search() and erase()

bytesReceived.description: Number of bytes received so far from the host, without considering file compression.

cookieStoreId.description: The cookie store ID of the contextual identity.

danger.description: Indication of whether this download is thought to be safe or known to be suspicious.

endedAfter.description: Limits results to downloads that ended after the given ms since the epoch.

endedBefore.description: Limits results to downloads that ended before the given ms since the epoch.

fileSize.description: Number of bytes in the whole file post-decompression, or -1 if unknown.

filenameRegex.description: Limits results to DownloadItems whose filename matches the given regular expression.

limit.description: Setting this integer limits the number of results. Otherwise, all matching DownloadItems will be returned.

orderBy.description: Setting elements of this array to DownloadItem properties in order to sort the search results. For example, setting orderBy='startTime' sorts the DownloadItems by their start time in ascending order. To specify descending order, prefix orderBy with a hyphen: '-startTime'.

paused.description: True if the download has stopped reading data from the host, but kept the connection open.

query.description: This array of search terms limits results to DownloadItems whose filename or url contain all of the search terms that do not begin with a dash '-' and none of the search terms that do begin with a dash.

startedAfter.description: Limits results to downloads that started after the given ms since the epoch.

startedBefore.description: Limits results to downloads that started before the given ms since the epoch.

state.description: Indicates whether the download is progressing, interrupted, or complete.

totalBytes.description: Number of bytes in the whole file, without considering file compression, or -1 if unknown.

totalBytesGreater.description: Limits results to downloads whose totalBytes is greater than the given integer.

totalBytesLess.description: Limits results to downloads whose totalBytes is less than the given integer.

urlRegex.description: Limits results to DownloadItems whose url matches the given regular expression.
